regions.name: Texas (statewide)
regions.coverageNote: Statewide help lines only. County-specific contacts are in the tx-25-counties pack.

contact.phoneNote: Dial 2-1-1 or 877-541-7905 and select your language. Option 1: services in your area. Option 4 (via 2-1-1): STEAR registration. Menu options as listed on the official page on 2026-10-09; may change.

resources.name: 2-1-1 Texas
resources.publisher: Texas Health and Human Services (2-1-1 Texas)
resources.summary: Information about local services, including disaster-related help.

contact.phoneNote: Dial 2-1-1 (or 877-541-7905), select language, then Option 4. Online registration at stear.texas.gov.

resources.name: State of Texas Emergency Assistance Registry (STEAR)
resources.summary: Voluntary, external registration. Information is shared with local emergency planners, responders, and participating local governments. Registering does NOT guarantee that you will receive a specific service or assistance during an emergency. Dry Run never registers you or sends your household profile.

resources.name: Texas Division of Emergency Management
resources.summary: State emergency management agency; administers STEAR.

contact.phoneNote: FEMA application line as listed by USAGov on 2026-10-09.

resources.name: FEMA disaster assistance (DisasterAssistance.gov)
resources.summary: FEMA financial assistance requires living in a presidentially declared disaster area, and not everyone qualifies for every program. Many fires and outages are not declared disasters; state agencies and other organizations may help instead.

resources.name: National Weather Service
resources.summary: Official watches, warnings, and forecasts. Dry Run shows NWS alert text unchanged when online.

sources.title: State of Texas Emergency Assistance Registry
